entries.17a2c1f5fb34ad9b: Supermarkets selling food, household goods and clothing. The company operates them, with 44 stores in Yamagata Prefecture and 18 in Miyagi Prefecture, for a total of 62 stores. It also runs the mobile supermarket “Tokushimaru,” which visits customers' homes with goods loaded in a vehicle. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥92,333 million, making it the largest business in the group.
entries.1bf9be9b26a1199d: The group consists of the company, three subsidiaries and one associate. It operates supermarkets in Yamagata and Miyagi prefectures and is also engaged in drugstores and food manufacturing. Its head office is in Yamagata City, Yamagata Prefecture, and its consolidated number of employees is 1,107 (as of February 28, 2026).

entries.60c3429f57d01a27: This business sells pharmaceuticals and cosmetics and operates dispensing pharmacies. It is operated by consolidated subsidiary Yamazawa Yakuhin Co., Ltd. entries.7812b0f742ce6cc3: This business manufactures and sells prepared foods such as sushi and rice dishes, and daily-delivery products such as milk and noodles. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2 million, and most of its sales are within the group.
